title: Production Water-Thermal Provenance Readiness
scope: audit-only current-canonical callsite and quadrature readiness

findings.finding: Restricted soil temperature is advanced inside the same model trial state as the Richards candidate before the outer F-KT candidate is materialized.
Opaque F-KT candidate lineage, origin revision and requested interval are assigned only after run_canonical_interval completes successfully.
A ready kernel_candidate_state_t can expose a cloned physical snapshot without exposing or allowing mutation of its private provenance.
The candidate physical snapshot can contain the optional soil_temperature_state_t, and the existing soil-temperature contract can materialize a typed soil_temperature_field_view_t from that state.
The serialized backend provides bottom outward exchange for each successful model trial as minus bottom_flux times accepted step duration, with positive sign outward from SWAP.

run_canonical_interval accumulates bottom exchange only from transaction_result_t values whose status is TX_STATUS_ACCEPTED and publishes the aggregate only when the complete requested interval finishes.
canonical_mass_accounting_t retains accepted_transaction_count, so a caller can distinguish a single accepted transaction from a multi-substep accepted interval.
The F-MR18 accepted commit receipt exists only after a successful outer F-KT commit and carries lineage, origin revision, committed revision and [t0,t1].
Current canonical does not retain a per-accepted-substep bottom donor-temperature history or a per-substep accepted bottom advective-energy integral.
The terminal soil-temperature field view plus aggregate bottom water exchange is insufficient to reconstruct physically correct interval advective energy when accepted_transaction_count exceeds one.

production_hook.trial_payload_stage: inside the accepted transaction/substep path where bottom exchange is still paired with that substep physical trial state
production_hook.outer_candidate_stage: after kernel candidate materialization for opaque lineage/revision/[t0,t1] provenance and candidate snapshot access
production_hook.publication_stage: only after the existing accepted F-MR18 commit receipt authorizes the exact outer candidate identity
production_hook.forbidden_shortcut: aggregate bottom exchange multiplied by terminal candidate bottom-node temperature for a multi-substep interval

required_next_capability.name: accepted bottom advective-energy quadrature carrier
required_next_capability.semantics: accumulate a donor-correct thermal contribution for each accepted bottom-water transfer before aggregation destroys substep temperature history, while publishing nothing from rejected trials
required_next_capability.dependency_rule: reuse admitted liquid-water enthalpy and provenance contracts; do not duplicate them while EB-I04/EB-I08/EB-I09/EB-I10 remain owner-only
